items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives conditions on a functor and a site under which the category of neighbourhoods is directed, and deduces left exactness of the associated stalk functor (statement lines 8484-8498). The proof is a complete verification of the defining properties of a directed category: nonemptiness follows from the first assumption; an upper bound for two neighbourhoods is produced by taking the fibre product, using compatibility with fibre products (proof lines 8502-8510); and an equalizer is produced by writing it in terms of fibre products and using compatibility with them (proof lines 8511-8521); the concluding clause is then the companion result (proof line 8522). The non-formal content is the construction of the upper bounds and equalizers. The claim is H2: a structured verification with each input named.
